candidate_workaround: Follow the skill's exact required-reference link and read references/schema.md instead of guessing a filename.
failure_signature: A read-only skill refresh guessed a nonexistent schema filename and returned a file-not-found error after the complete skill text had already named the correct reference.
recurrence_guard: Resolve required references from the exact link in SKILL.md; never derive or guess a schema filename from the skill title.
rollback: Retain the failed guessed-path read with zero schema credit and make no ledger change until the exact linked schema is read.
scope_boundary: Same-owner skill-reference recovery only; no scientific, professional, legal, cultural, Maori-authority, production, security, accessibility, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Resolve skill references from exact links
trigger_preconditions: A selected skill names a required local reference that must be read before action.
